root_claim: A vendor can ship GPLv2-covered firmware on a locked device: publish corresponding source, keep users from installing a modified binary.
failed_or_unsupported_leaf: GPLv2 §3: distribute object code with a written source offer. Constraint text holds; the user's install/run-modified handle does not fire (tivoization).
binding_leaf: GPLv3 §6 Installation Information: information required to install and execute modified versions on the User Product, from the same source that required the corresponding source.
stop: New license text after the silent gap; successors that adopt GPLv3 take on the install handle. Does not rewrite already-shipped GPLv2-only devices.
